text: You're looking for a quick and protein-rich meal that fits your vegetarian diet and time constraints. This Mexican Scrambled Eggs recipe is a great fit. It combines eggs, black beans, and cream cheese to provide a good amount of protein, while the salsa and cilantro add flavor without adding excess calories. The dish is also relatively low in carbs and sugar, making it a good choice for your health goals. With a preparation time of about 10 minutes, it's a convenient option for a busy day.
